title: THIS
description: Port of the Chickens mod, as well as roost!
body:
A revisit to the old but gold, Chickens, More Chickens, and Roost, brought to 1.21.1! Heavy WIP.

Breed different material chickens for renewable resources. Provides a steady source of the material of the chicken, especially if the chicken is a higher level

Find the original mod [here](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/chickens). We plan to include most of not all this content, but brought to 1.21.1 and possibly later versions

To get a guide book, install patchouli, and then in-game, craft the THIS Field Guide!
